description: Check whether the work is actually finished rather than finished-looking — what was promised versus what really runs. Several models compare the task against the code, and every completion claim has to survive a command that was actually executed. Use before calling something done, before a PR, at the end of a session, or on "is this done", "did I finish", "check if done", "what did we skip".
